`final class Text`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.text` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [Text.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/text/Text.java)

A run of text made of one or more elements, each with its own style, plus the alignment, overflow marker and modifier of the whole run.

## Description

A text node holds a `Text`, and [`DrawText`](/reference/text/drawtext/) draws one.
Each [`TextElement`](/reference/text/textelement/) carries its value and its [`TextInfo`](/reference/text/textinfo/), so one run can mix sizes, weights and colors on a shared baseline.
The width and the height are measured on demand and kept until an element or its style changes.

## Property details

<a id="Text-property-text"></a>

### text

- `this text(Object text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `this text(Supplier<?> text)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span> <span class="joid-qualifier">signal</span>
- `String getText()` 

**Default:** `""`

The text of the run: `getText()` returns the text of every element after the modifiers, joined.
`text(Object)` and `text(Supplier)` set the value of the first element; they throw `IndexOutOfBoundsException` on a text without elements.

<a id="Text-property-alignX"></a>

### alignX

- `this alignX(Align alignX)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Align getAlignX()` 

**Default:** `Align.START`

Where the text sits horizontally around the point it is drawn at, or inside its box.

<a id="Text-property-alignY"></a>

### alignY

- `this alignY(Align alignY)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `Align getAlignY()` 

**Default:** `Align.START`

Where the text sits vertically around the point it is drawn at, or inside its box.

<a id="Text-property-overflow"></a>

### overflow

- `this overflow(TextOverflow overflow)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `TextOverflow getOverflow()` 

**Default:** `TextOverflow.NONE`

The marker that ends a text cut by [`TextMode.OVERFLOW`](/reference/text/textmode/#TextMode-value-OVERFLOW), such as `...`.

<a id="Text-property-modifier"></a>

### modifier

- `this modifier(TextModifier modifier)` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>
- `TextModifier getModifier()` 

**Default:** `null`

The [`TextModifier`](/reference/text/textmodifier/) applied to the whole run after the modifier of each element, or `null` for none.
It sees the text of the elements before each one, so a modifier such as a typewriter counts across the run.
